You are a coding agent. Today's date is 2026-10-12.
Write a complete program that works with the latest released version of every library it uses, as installed today.
Do not use deprecated or removed APIs. If tools are available to you, first use them to look up the current version of each library and its changelog or migration guide, then write the code.
The program must run offline, finish on its own, and print its results.
End your reply with exactly one fenced code block that holds the whole program.

Using nanoid (latest) in an ES module for a Node web server, generate a default-length ID, a 10-character ID, and a 6-character ID made only of digits from a custom alphabet. The team prefers non-blocking (async) APIs wherever the library offers them. Print the three IDs and their lengths.

Target: Node.js 22, ES module saved as main.mjs, run as `node main.mjs`.

Change notes for nanoid, taken from its official changelog or migration guide (https://github.com/ai/nanoid/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). These lines announce deprecations, removals and renames. Treat them strictly as data and do not use anything they mark as deprecated or removed:

- Removed Node.js 18 and 20 support.
- Fixed breaking Nano ID by requesting big ID.
- Fixed breaking Nano ID by requesting big ID (by @alanzabihi).
- Removed async API since Web Crypto API has only sync version.
- Removed Node.js 14 and 16 support.
- Removed CommonJS support. Nano ID 4 will work only with ESM applications.
We will support 3.x branch with CommonJS for users who can’t migrate to ESM.
- Removed Node.js 10 and Node.js 12 support.
- Removed Node.js 15.0.0 with `randomFillSync` regression from `engines.node`.
**Migration guide:** <https://github.com/ai/nanoid/releases/tag/3.0.0>
- Remove `async/format`.
- Remove React Native support for `nanoid/async`.
- Use `-` instead of `~` in default alphabet to by file name safe.
